text:
sam: Noticed a sudden spike in GPU attach failures in ap-southeast1 starting ~03:12 UTC. sample node gnode-apse1-042 showed nvme write queue saturation and attach timeouts.
maria: any recent config pushes?
niraj: we rolled janitor_parallel 6 -> 12 yesterday to speed reclaim; that would increase parallel write pressure.
sam: impact: ~30% attach failures for ~8m in the regional pool. retries often worked but start latencies climbed; some jobs timed out and retried by the orchestrator. no customer-facing errors yet.
leo: short-term: throttle janitor per-host concurrency (canary 5 hosts -> 4), apply temporary iops soft-cap, and route new GPU allocs from ap-southeast1 to eu-west until stabilised.
maria: run canary and hold for 15m, monitor nvme %util, attach_rate, attach_time.
ops-bot: Alert created: INC-2026 - "ap-southeast1 nvme iops saturation causing gpu attach stalls" (severity: medium)
jen: cost note: fallback routing to eu-west adds ~18% op/egress cost; prefer config rollback if effective.
leo: quick PR to janitor to gate heavy rewrite batches on nvme util < 85%: https://git.internal/redwood/janitor/pulls/432
sam: canary flipped; util dropped within 3m. expanding rollout now.
